description: Figure 1 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the accuracy of three different algorithms across two tweet categories. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis," displays two categories from left to right: "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweet." The vertical value axis, labeled "Accuracy," uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2 and corresponding dashed horizontal gridlines. The chart features grouped bars, with a cluster of three bars for each of the two x-axis categories. A legend in the bottom right corner of the chart area defines the visual representation of the three algorithms: "TEXTBLOB" is represented by white bars with bottom-left to top-right diagonal hatching, "VADER" is represented by white bars with top-left to bottom-right diagonal hatching, and "ChatGPT" is represented by solid green bars. All bars have black outlines. Within the "Emoji Tweets" category, the TEXTBLOB bar is the shortest in the chart at approximately 0.33, followed by the VADER bar at approximately 0.46, and the ChatGPT bar at approximately 0.67. In the "Overall Tweet" category, the TEXTBLOB bar reaches exactly 0.4, the VADER bar is approximately 0.47, and the ChatGPT bar is again approximately 0.67, making the two ChatGPT bars the tallest in the chart. The bars within each group are ordered from left to right as TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT. The ChatGPT bars are visually emphasized through the use of a solid green fill color, contrasting with the hatched, uncolored patterns of the other two algorithms.
